5. We now have 6 cobblestone (for making granite walls or other crafting items) plus we have the 1 comparator.
6. With more cobblestone gathering, we can now focus on creating 1 granite using the formula provided (which needs 1 diorite and 1 quartz; we already have 1 quartz and need to finish making 2 diorites for polishing).
7. Once we have enough cobblestone (from step 5 and 6), we will start crafting 6 granite slabs with the 3 granite blocks we make in this process (from having 1 diorite and enough cobblestone).
8. This sequence ensures that we are building up resources incrementally, making sure that each time we craft something, it helps us gather more ingredients without running out.

- Use 4 quartz to craft 2 polished diorite and 1 comparator.
- Collect 3 cobblestones and 5 planks.

- Combine the 2 diorites and 1 quartz to craft 1 polished diorite.
- Collect the remaining cobblestone needed for 1 to 2 diorites if required.
- With enough cobblestone (now 6 or more), create 1 granite.
- Craft 6 granite slabs using the 3 granite.

This approach ensures we gather all the necessary items in a logical sequence, ultimately leading to the desired goal of crafting 6 granite slabs.
